notes.title: July 2025 Update Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm putting out a new update to all platforms that covers some housekeeping, new features, quality of life, and important bug fixes. Changes are as follows:

[list]
[*] Improved Steam Link support (Added Hand Tracking)
[*] Merged Meta & PCVR Leaderboards (Effective to new scores)
[*] Fixed Turret Firing Code
[*] Leaving the Turbolifts no longer drops the NPC call selection screen
[*] Added laser pointer effect to Wiring Schematic's tracking
[*] Removed time duration of PsyOps invisibility perk
[*] Fixed victory condition bug
[*] Fixed potential soft lock condition in the tutorial
[*] Minor improvement to tutorial clarity
[*] Removed remaining OVR related functionality
[*] Fixed Leaderboard UI Scrolling
[*] Fixed Weapon Crafting Icon Indicators
[*] Fixed Projectile Effect Particles (Incendiary / Toxic)
[*] Modified Laser Projectile (Increased Visibility / Readability)
[*] Added Weapon Crafting Recipe Tooltips
[/list]

notes.title: Rogue Ascent is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Rogue Ascent VR is Now Live on Steam with Enhanced Controller Support[/h1]

Hey everyone,

We're excited to share that Rogue Ascent VR is now available on Steam! This launch is a big step for us, and we're eager for you to experience the game with enhanced controller support and some new features we've added.

[b]Development Journey[/b]
Since Rogue Ascent VR debuted on the Meta Quest platform, it has received positive feedback, earning a 4.7 out of 5 stars. The hand-tracking combat and detailed environments have been well-received, and we've built a solid player base. We've been continuously working to improve the game, thanks to the support from Clique Games and the dedication of our team Nooner Bear Studio.

[b]New Features for Steam Players[/b]
Steam players can now enjoy Rogue Ascent VR with all the latest updates and modes, including the Sandbox mode. This mode allows for a lot of customization and experimentation, which we think many of you will enjoy.

We've also added enhanced controller support. This means you can now use controllers for a more intuitive shooting experience, complete with homing fire and different input styles. We aimed to make the game accessible and enjoyable for both new and experienced players.

Additionally, the Steam version includes native Twitch integration. This makes it easier for you to stream your gameplay and engage with the community in real-time. We hope this feature will help you share your experiences and connect with other players.

[b]About Nooner Bear Studio[/b]
Nooner Bear Studio is a VR development studio based in Indianapolis, led by Jordan McGraw. We focus on creating immersive experiences using emerging technology and are committed to delivering quality VR content.
